# Repository Instructions

Read `START_HERE.md` before working. Use `AI.md` for stable project truth and `STATE.md` for the current handoff.

Treat repository documentation as authoritative over chat history. Preserve the Power BI, SPA, backend/API, and operational-store boundaries. Do not move analytics into frontend code unnecessarily, use Excel as production write-back, or assume enterprise capabilities without evidence.

Keep changes scoped, preserve unrelated work, run relevant checks, review the diff, and update `STATE.md` after meaningful work. Do not push, merge, deploy, connect new systems, or change production without authorization.
